name: pi-desktop
description: A local desktop workspace for Pi coding agent
author: Pi Desktop contributors

scripts.test:session-lease: node scripts/native.mjs cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --no-default-features --features test-fixture --bin pi-session-lease && node tests/session-lease-check.mjs
scripts.test:rust:fixture: node scripts/native.mjs cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --no-default-features --features test-fixture
scripts.test:ui: npm run build:test && pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/run-tauri-ui-medium.ps1
scripts.test:pi: node scripts/native.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --bin pi-rpc-check
scripts.test:context: node scripts/native.mjs cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --no-default-features --bin pi-workspace-check
scripts.build:test: npm run build && node scripts/native.mjs cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --no-default-features --features test-fixture --bin pi-session-lease --bin acp-fixture --bin mcp-fixture && node scripts/native.mjs build --debug --no-bundle --features test-fixture
